title: Extract WebChat attachment/message-part service boundary before dashboard media storage
description: Introduce explicit message-part and attachment service boundaries before adding dashboard media upload/history storage.

files.change: Keep WebChat HTTP route handlers thin and put typed message part normalization in a dedicated module.
Prepare upload/storage lookup boundary without tying routes to concrete storage.
Prepare conversation history DTO assembly separately from platform internals.

criteria: Existing WebChat routes keep current behavior.
Attachment/history services are ports or thin modules, not dashboard-specific logic.
Message part conversion keeps AstrBot's webchat helper ideas while using Rust typed DTOs.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-web && cargo test -p astrbot-platform && cargo test --workspace
